# EZ Finish Auto

> Mobile car detailing serving all cities across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) in Ontario, Canada. The vehicle stays where it is parked, at home, at work, or anywhere else, and the detailing comes to it.

## Services and pricing (CAD, starting prices)

- Sedans, from $90: interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires, vacuum and steam cleaning
- SUVs, from $125: interior wipe down, interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires
- Vans and trucks, from $155: full interior and exterior packages, interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires

## Service area

All cities across the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario.

## How it works

EZ Finish Auto is a mobile service. There is no shop to drive to. A detailer travels to the customer's location anywhere in the Greater Toronto Area and details the vehicle in place, whether that is a driveway, a workplace parking lot, or a street parking spot.
